description: This file contains memory management functions for a specific project, including custom malloc, calloc, realloc, strdup, and memory cleanup functions, as well as internal data structures and macros for managing memory lists.

methods.name: __dmcleanmem
methods.description: Cleans up all memory in a list.

methods.name: dmfree
methods.description: Frees a memory block allocated by this module.

methods.name: __dmmalloc
methods.description: Allocates memory and adds it to a list.

methods.name: __dmcalloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory and adds it to a list.

methods.name: __dmstrdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string into managed memory.

methods.name: __dmasprintf
methods.description: Formats a string into managed memory.

methods.name: dm_init_mem
methods.description: Initializes the memory management for a context.

methods.name: dm_clean_mem
methods.description: Cleans up all memory associated with a context.

methods.name: dm_calloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory within a context.

methods.name: dm_strdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string within a context.

methods.name: dm_asprintf
methods.description: Formats a string into a managed buffer within a context.
